flashcard_questions.q: What is energy insecurity in a country?
flashcard_questions.a: Not having a reliable or affordable supply of energy to meet people's needs.

flashcard_questions.q: Which country regularly diverts electricity from homes to industry at peak demand?
What is fracking as a method of extraction?
flashcard_questions.a: Extracting natural gas from shale rock by injecting high-pressure water, sand and chemicals.

flashcard_questions.q: What does the high-pressure injection create in the shale rock?
flashcard_questions.a: Fissures, which are cracks that release the trapped gas.

flashcard_questions.q: Which company ran the fracking operations near Blackpool?
How many jobs did Cuadrilla create at its sites near Blackpool?
How much would fracking earn Blackpool Council each year in business rates?
By how much could fracking reduce UK energy prices each year?
What was found in water near fracking sites, making it unusable?
Why can fracking contaminate underground water supplies?
flashcard_questions.a: Drilling lets gas and oil mix with the groundwater.

flashcard_questions.q: Which two roads near Blackpool suffer congestion from fracking lorries?
What is a moratorium in the UK fracking debate?
flashcard_questions.a: A temporary ban imposed by the government.

flashcard_questions.q: Fracking in the UK was suspended in ____ after a magnitude 2.9 earthquake near Blackpool.
Why is natural gas seen as a cleaner fossil fuel than coal?
flashcard_questions.a: It produces less carbon dioxide when it is burned.

flashcard_questions.q: How does fracking improve the UK's energy security?
flashcard_questions.a: It reduces reliance on importing gas from other countries.

notes: 15 cards: 3 term-to-definition (energy insecurity, fracking, moratorium), 6 case-study-to-fact naming Blackpool or Cuadrilla with one figure each (jobs, business rates, price cut, methane, roads, company), 4 cause-to-consequence (water contamination, cleaner than coal, import reliance, fissures), 1 cloze on the 2019 suspension, 1 place card (South Africa blackouts). The magnitude-3 tremors were dropped so they could not interfere with the magnitude-2.9 figure that triggered the moratorium, which is kept inside the cloze question.
